class.name: ActivityManager
class.brief_description: Manages the Activity back stack, Dialogs, and Toast queue.
class.description:
ActivityManager is the runtime engine behind the Activity system. It maintains the back stack, resolves Intents to registered Activity scenes, drives lifecycle callbacks, runs enter/exit transitions, and manages the Dialog overlay list and Toast FIFO queue.
Owned by [Application]. Users mostly interact with it indirectly through [Context] and [Activity] convenience methods, but direct access is available via [method Application.get_activity_manager] for debug inspection methods like [method get_stack_activity], [method get_dialog], etc.

method.name: back
method.description: Triggers the system back gesture. Returns [code]false[/code] if the stack is empty.

method.name: cleanup_all
method.description: Drains all Activities, Dialogs, and Toasts. Called by [method Application.shutdown].

method.name: dismiss_dialog
method.description: Dismisses a specific Dialog.

method.name: finish_activity
method.description: Finishes (destroys) a specific Activity, cleaning up its owned Dialogs and Toasts.

method.name: finish_top
method.description: Finishes the top Activity in the stack.

method.name: get_application
method.description: Returns the owning [Application].

method.name: get_current_activity
method.description: Returns the current top Activity.

method.name: get_dialog
method.description: Returns the Dialog at [param idx] in the overlay list. Debug inspection only.

method.name: get_dialog_count
method.description: Returns the number of active Dialogs.

method.name: get_root
method.description: Returns the root [Control] container.

method.name: get_stack_activity
method.description: Returns the Activity at [param idx] in the back stack (0 = bottom). Debug inspection only.

method.name: get_stack_size
method.description: Returns the number of Activities in the back stack.

method.name: get_toast_queue_count
method.description: Returns the number of Toasts waiting in the queue.

method.name: get_toast_queue_item
method.description: Returns the Toast at [param idx] in the pending queue. Debug inspection only.

method.name: is_toast_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a Toast is currently being displayed.

method.name: register_activity
method.description: Registers an Activity scene ([code].tscn[/code]) for the given action string. When an Intent with this action is started, the scene is instantiated.

method.name: set_root
method.description: Sets the root [Control] container under which all Activities, Dialogs, and Toasts are added.

method.name: show_dialog
method.description: Shows a Dialog. Owner defaults to the current top Activity.

method.name: show_dialog_with_owner
method.description: Shows a Dialog with an explicit lifecycle owner.

method.name: show_toast
method.description: Enqueues a Toast for display.

method.name: show_toast_with_owner
method.description: Enqueues a Toast with an explicit lifecycle owner.

method.name: start_activity
method.description: Starts a new Activity based on [param intent].action, applying any [Intent] flags.
